reference_inputs.role: User-supplied scene: asphalt palette and surface character; no original bytes included in runtime.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: overhead asphalt material for the street in the attached RefDesign.png strategy-game scene. The attached image is the exact visual style reference; study ONLY the paved street. Paint a full square opaque material swatch of that same modest medium-dark neutral grey asphalt, diffuse top-down light, subtle fine aggregate, faint irregular wear and low-contrast gentle mottling. Average colour near RGB(91,94,93). Keep the grain small and restrained at strategy-game scale; asphalt should read smooth from a distance with crisp fine texture at high resolution. The reference street is a maintained grey paved road, not loose gravel or cobblestone, not shiny black tarmac. Fill the entire canvas uniformly with asphalt, no large cracks, potholes or gravel rocks. Do NOT draw an actual road strip, junction, curved road, lane lines, edge lines, curbs, grass or objects; the Go renderer adds road shape, lane markings and shoulders. No directional gradients, perspective, text, grid, border, hex outline or transparency. Only the asphalt material in the reference's painted realistic 2D game style.
processing: Master preserved unchanged. Go renders shared texture, dusty shoulders, thin dashed centre and continuous edge lines along the existing reciprocal road curves.
